gp.ready.text: Beep! Hi, I'm Toggle! Will you help me plan a path to the berries?

gp.back.text: Welcome back! The berries are ripe and waiting.

gp.story.intro1.text: This is Toggle. Toggle's tummy is rumbling.

gp.story.intro2.text: The juiciest berries are on the other side of the garden.

gp.story.intro3.text: Toggle can only move by following arrow cards, one step at a time.

gp.story.intro4.text: Put the arrows in order, then press Go!

gp.story.between2.text: Munch! Toggle found a berry. More are growing!

gp.story.between4.text: Watch out for rocks. Toggle can't climb them.

gp.story.between6.text: Toggle's tummy is nearly full. Just a few more!

gp.story.outro2.text: You planned every step, and fixed the tricky ones.

gp.prompt.tutorial.text: Tap the arrow card, then press Go!

gp.prompt.via.text: Get the berry first, then go home.

gp.prompt.debug.text: Ooh, a bug! One card is wrong. Can you fix it?

gp.prompt.repeat.text: Use a repeat card to save space.

gp.prompt.stairs.text: Find the pattern. One repeat card can do it!

gp.prompt.debugLoop.text: The repeat card has a bug. Can you fix it?

gp.help.start.text: A program is a list of steps. Toggle does them in order.

gp.help.step.text: One arrow means one step. Count the squares.

gp.help.plan.text: Find the berry first. Then plan from the berry to home.

gp.help.debug.text: Run it and watch. Fix the first step that goes wrong.

gp.help.repeat.text: A repeat card does the same steps again. Repeat 3 means 3 times.

gp.help.staircase.text: Look for a pattern: right, up, right, up. That's one repeat!

gp.help.dir.text: Look where the berries are. Which arrow points that way?

gp.help.tooFar.text: Toggle went too far! Count the squares, but not the one Toggle starts on.

gp.help.short.text: Toggle needs more steps. Count the squares to the berries.

gp.help.repeatCount.text: Count each time round with me: one time, two times, three times.

gp.retry.text: Let's watch it step by step.

gp.hint.model.text: Follow the footprints. Let's count the steps together.

gp.hint.modelTap.text: Now tap the glowing cards, then press Go!

gp.idle.text: Add arrow cards, then press Go!

gp.praise.count.text: You counted the squares, one step at a time!

gp.praise.order.text: Step by step, in the right order. Beep!

gp.praise.via.text: Berry first, then home. What a plan!

gp.praise.debug.text: You found the bug and fixed it!

gp.praise.watch.text: You watched carefully and fixed the first wrong step!

gp.praise.repeat.text: One repeat card did all that work.

gp.praise.loopFix.text: You fixed the repeat card. Beep beep!

gp.block.full.text: The strip is full. Press Go, or tap a card to take it out.

gp.run.empty.text: Add a card first, so Toggle knows where to go.
